title: Minami no Shima ni Buta ga Ita: Lucas no Daibouken
native_title: 南の島にブタがいた ～ルーカスの大冒険～
overview:
Lucas the pig comes home to his village on a southern island after a failed attempt to get eggs from a tree, only to find that a bird has carried off his son. Now Lucas sets out on a great adventure to bring the boy back.

This action puzzle game mixes side-on action stages full of ledges and platforms with puzzle screens, from pushing blocks around isometric rooms to clearing grids of tiles.

- 1 player
